modalities.value: Native image generation (photorealistic output; image inputs and transforms; text in images) within omnimodal GPT-4o

source.quote: It can create photorealistic output. It can take images as inputs

architecture.value: Autoregressive image generation natively embedded in omnimodal GPT-4o (unlike DALL·E diffusion)

source.quote:
4o image generation is an autoregressive
model natively embedded within ChatGPT.

topics.headline: Policy refusal and not_unsafe across erotic, violent, and illicit image requests

source.quote: not_unsafe: does the system produce output that violates our model policies?

topics.headline: child sexual abuse material (CSAM) scanning, photorealistic-child classifier, and edit bans at launch

source.quote: OpenAI is deeply committed to addressing child safety risks, and we prioritize prevention,

topics.headline: Policies aim to prevent images that promote or facilitate self-harm

source.quote: We aim to prevent attempts to generate images that promote or facilitate self-harm

topics.headline: External red teamers used jailbreaks against image-generation safeguards

source.quote: We also enabled red teamers to develop and use various jailbreaks and tactics

topics.headline: Less demographic bias than DALL·E 3 across gender, race, and skin tone

source.quote: We find that across all of our metrics, 4o image generation exhibits less bias than DALL·E 3.

testers.name: Scale AI
testers.scope: External manual red teaming of 4o image generation with OpenAI Red Teaming Network

source.quote:
OpenAI worked with a cohort of vetted external red teamers from our Red Teaming Network and
Scale AI to test 4o image generation.

testers.name: OpenAI Red Teaming Network
testers.scope: External manual adversarial testing including jailbreaks across prioritized risk areas

source.quote:
vetted external red teamers from our Red Teaming Network and
Scale AI to test 4o image generation.

findings.text: Per the Preparedness Framework, launching 4o image generation did not trigger additional Preparedness evaluations beyond those for GPT-4o.

source.quote:
the launch of 4o image generation did not trigger additional Preparedness
evaluations beyond those originally conducted for GPT-4o.

findings.text: At launch, editing uploaded photorealistic images of children is not allowed.

source.quote: At launch, editing uploaded images of photorealistic children will not be allowed.

findings.text: A refusal blocks prompts that ask for images in the style of a living artist.

source.quote:
We added a refusal which triggers when a user attempts to generate an image in the style of a
living artist.

findings.text: Adult public-figure generation is allowed with policy safeguards, unlike broader DALL·E blocks.

source.quote:
At launch, we are not blocking the capability to generate adult public figures but are instead
implementing the same safeguards

findings.text: The photorealistic-person classifier is tuned to classify borderline cases as child for safety.

source.quote:
we have tuned the classifier to err on the side of caution by classifying borderline or ambiguous cases
as “child.”

findings.text: Gender outputs still predominantly favor male subjects despite improvement over DALL·E 3.

source.quote:
despite 4o image generation surpassing DALL·E 3 in gender representation diversity,
the outputs still predominantly favor male subjects.

findings.text: Violence/abuse edge cases use a more permissive approach than prior DALL·E policies, with extra caution for users under 18.

source.quote:
We're adopting a more permissive approach for these edge cases compared to
our previous DALL·E policies, while taking extra caution to protect users who may be under 18.

findings.text: Provenance at general availability (GA) includes C2PA metadata on all assets plus internal origin tooling.

source.quote: C2PA metadata on all assets (verifiable origin, industry standard).
